description: A new student writes in Roman Urdu with no opening posted: intro, then the bank skips what the student already covered or the Vault already holds; after three bank questions in a row the missing education comes first, then the bank resumes.

writer: Walaikum assalam! Main PAI hoon, tumhara counselor. Apne baare mein batao: aaj kal kya karte ho aur tumhare liye kya important hai?

turns.student: Main FSc kar raha hoon, free time mein cricket khelta hoon aur thori coding bhi karta hoon.
writer: Cricket aur coding dono mein kuch banane aur jeetne wali soch dikhti hai. Koi aisi cheez hai jo tumne achieve ki ho aur tumhare liye sach mein matter karti ho?

extract.quote: free time mein cricket khelta hoon

turns.student: Haan, school ke science fair mein robot bana kar first aaya tha.
writer: Robot khud banana aur us par jeetna engineering ki taraf ek asli ishara hai. Tumhare background, family ya sheher ne tumhare liye kaunse darwaze khole ya mushkil banaye?

proposed_value.title: First place at the school science fair with a robot

extract.quote: school ke science fair mein robot bana kar first aaya tha

turns.student: Hamari family mein koi engineer nahi, abbu dukaan chalate hain aur main shaam ko unki madad karta hoon.
writer: Shaam ko dukaan sambhalna bhi zimmedari aur hisaab ki samajh deta hai. Matric mein tumhara group kya tha aur marks kitne aaye?

proposed_value.text: Helps his father at the family shop in the evenings

extract.quote: main shaam ko unki madad karta hoon

turns.student: Matric science mein kiya, 1000 mein se 920 aaye.
writer: Science ke saath achhe marks engineering ka raasta khula rakhte hain. Koi aisi mushkil jis ka tumne saamna kiya ho aur jis ne tumhare sochne ka tareeqa badla ho?
